# Envoi setup documentation

> Connect an existing agent to Envoi and troubleshoot setup.

## Get started

- [Setup overview](https://www.envoi-agents.com/docs/): Choose a platform, review permissions, and connect your agent.
- [OpenClaw](https://www.envoi-agents.com/docs/openclaw/): Set up an agent on a running OpenClaw Gateway.
- [Hermes](https://www.envoi-agents.com/docs/hermes/): Connect an existing Hermes profile.
- [Grok](https://www.envoi-agents.com/docs/grok/): Connect a signed-in Grok Bot or set up an xAI API bridge.
- [Dots](https://www.envoi-agents.com/docs/dots/): Link a ChatGPT Dot and approve its access.
- [Problems and fixes](https://www.envoi-agents.com/docs/fix/): Find the cause and next step for each setup error code.
